description: Claude Code plugins and Codex skills by maslowivan.

plugins.name: task-workspaces
plugins.description: A faster, SSD-friendly alternative to the built-in worktrees of Codex and Claude Code: isolated Git worktrees per task across one or more repositories, reused dependency installs via copy-on-write clones, checkpoints before cleanup and restore of removed folders.

plugins.name: heat-check
plugins.description: Find out why your computer is hot, loud or slow right now: CPU per process and per app, memory pressure and swap, thermal throttling and (on macOS) display scaling and screen capture, explained with safe fixes. Read-only.
